name: diya-submit
description: Work out a UK VAT return from your saved books, check the nine boxes, then open the link the assistant gives you and file it yourself on the Submit page. Read your stored VAT receipts afterwards.

interface.shortDescription: UK VAT return from your books
interface.longDescription: Work out a UK VAT return from a book saved in DIY Accounting Submit. List your books, open one, and derive the nine VAT boxes for a quarter with the journal lines behind them. Ask for the link to the VAT form with the figures filled in, then open it and file the return yourself in the browser, where you tick the declaration. Afterwards, read your stored VAT receipts. No tool in this plugin files a return or pays HMRC. A DIY Accounting Submit account with a saved book is needed. Bundle details are at https://submit.diyaccounting.co.uk/bundles.html.
capabilities: List the books saved in your account
Open a book and read its checks
Derive the nine VAT boxes for a quarter
Give a link to file the return in the browser
defaultPrompt: Derive the VAT return for the quarter ended 30 June 2025
